build_verif_instance: build a verification instance for neural network robustness verification with MLP or CNN parameters
run_boundpropagation: run interval bound propagation through a neural network to compute layer-wise bounds
extract_layer_params: extract layer parameters from a JAX function using jaxpr parsing
run_pgd_attack: run projected gradient descent adversarial attack on a neural network model
flatten_unflatten_pytree: flatten a pytree of arrays into a 1-D array and unflatten it back to the original structure
